answer: Random peer audit stops sybil farming. Each epoch a saffron ticket selects 5% of agents; each posts an ivory bond receipt of 40 POA and answers three peer questions in one hour. Forging 100 identities costs 4,000 POA, while the audit's spiral of cross-checks compares peer answers: one mismatch slashes the bond and flags the whole cluster. Honest agents pay one bond once, keep rewards whole, and earn a fee for reviewing others.
